newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Thursday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow. Demand light to moderate. Seller interest mostly light. Offerings current and light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Thursdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 109.00. Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales. Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1175 lbs few 109.00-110.00.
